description: Update the style for a lead form. If the form uses a default style, LPBE creates a custom style and attaches it to the form. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

borderRadius.description: Corner radius settings for the form.

button.description: Button style settings for the form.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

formId.description: Lead form ID, from a Nas.com lead form listing.

name: update_lead_form_style
